- Failing test: `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.flowCanvasChip-11665.test.tsx`, the zh case expecting the header title `API 名称: nightly_digest`. The shard otherwise reads Test Files 1 failed, 160 passed (161).
- Why it is not this PR's: the diff touches only the page designer's block inspector (`metadata-admin/previews/block-config.ts`, its `i18n.ts` labels and tests). Nothing in `studio-design/` or the studio catalogue changes. This is the known random red tracked as #26692 (the zh tooltip is read before the lazy studio catalogue lands).
- Fix: none exists yet; #26692 is open with no fix PR. Nothing is ported here.
- Re-run: the failed jobs of run 40535190704 get one re-run once the run completes, through the seat. A second red would be read as real.

The `engine.inspector.pageBlock.*` rows no longer live in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts`. #25922 slice S2 (PR #26780, merged as `4485536597`) moved them into the lazy `studio` namespace: `ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/{en,zh}.ts`. The three `engine.inspector.pageBlock.field.list-view.*` rows this PR adds belong there now. A key in both homes makes the i18n gate extractor throw, and a test that reads the zh label synchronously needs a top-level `await loadStudioCatalogue('zh')` (see `inspectorStrings.studioNamespace-25922.test.ts`). Slice S3 (in flight, `Part of #25922`) moves the rest of `engine.inspector`, `engine.packages`, `engine.form` and `engine.edit` next.
